# Dependency and licence inventory (generated by tools/gen_deps.py)

Licences are read from each package's own metadata/DESCRIPTION. **MetaLab itself has no licence chosen yet** - that is a decision for the project owner (see LICENSE_DECISION.md). Check each licence yourself before redistributing.

## Python (direct)
| package | version | licence (from metadata) |
|---|---|---|
| streamlit | 1.67.0 | Apache-2.0 |
| numpy | 2.5.3 | BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0 |
| scipy | 1.18.1 | BSD License |
| pandas | 3.0.5 | BSD License |
| plotly | 7.2.0 | MIT |
| pytest | 9.1.1 | MIT |

## R (used only for validation; not required to run the app)
| package | version | licence (DESCRIPTION) |
|---|---|---|
| metafor | 4.4-0 | GPL (>= 2) |
| metadat | 1.2-0 | GPL (>= 2) |
| jsonlite | 1.8.8 | MIT + file LICENSE |
| R | 4.3.3 | GPL-2 | GPL-3 (see R documentation) |

## Other
- Chromium/Playwright were used only for development screenshots (not a dependency).
- No fonts, images, icons or datasets are bundled except small published example datasets (BCG) identified in `metalab/datasets.py` with their source.
- Reference metadata comes from PubMed/Crossref records (bibliographic facts); no copyrighted article text is bundled.
- Risk-of-bias tool domain NAMES only; official tool texts/guidance are not reproduced.
